basic_info.description: Magnificently modern, casually chic, and sublimely sophisticated haven in San Francisco's coveted Russian Hill. Step inside the private elevator which opens to a soaring double-height ceiling with a floating catwalk spanning the foyer. Gazing forward into the huge Great Room, your eyes will flow effortlessly out to a verdantly landscaped private garden, offering over 1,500 sqft of outdoor entertaining space. Al fresco living at heart, it's the expansive flat outdoor space that's the real jewel here - kid friendly, pet friendly, safe and secure - perfect for the whole family to play, run, wine and dine. With an abundance of natural light pouring in, a gourmet chef's kitchen with a grand entertainer's island anchors the space with jewel-box allure. Upstairs are 3 spacious bedrooms, all with outdoor spaces, including the primary suite, which features a walk-in closet with bespoke built-ins, and a spacious ensuite bathroom with double vanity, soaking tub, open shower and luxury specifications throughout. Two guest bedrooms and a modern guest bathroom round out the top floor, which is also served by the elevator. With a home-office, full bath and laundry services on the main level, plus additional storage and easy independent parking, this house-like condo is the one not to miss!
